notes.title: 1.0.6 BUILD 19 - Level Design
notes.notes:
Hello!

I reworked the level design of the levels up to and including level 6.
I mainly moved mines that were too difficult to manage and removed areas without collectibles.
These first levels should therefore be less punitive.

Update to Unity 2022.3.50f1.

Unity 6 LTS is finally available, this may be the subject of another update.

I am currently working on my next and third game.
Feel free to follow my developer page to be informed of the launch of my next games.
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/MarsTouchStudio


Have a good game!

notes.title: UNDERWATER DIVING ALPHA DEMO AVAILABLE
notes.notes:
Good Morning! Good Afternoon! Good Evening! Good Night!

First of all thank you to all those who have chosen to follow the news of the game.

I am pleased to announce that the [b]Underwater Diving[/b] BETA demo is now available.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2427780

The purpose of this demo is to demonstrate the game mechanics and what the game experience will be like.
Please take into account that during the first levels you will have to favor avoidance maneuvers and choose your battles carefully.
Later, you will be able to face more and more opponents at the same time, up to epic battles.
The levels of the game will then become larger and larger, putting your sense of direction to the test.
I complete the game 100% in 4 hours, so for you in [b]at least 8 hours[/b].
I hope you have a good time playing it!

The biggest new features visible in this version is the correction of an error.
In fact, Medium Mines did the same damage as Small Mines.
This is fixed and the damage of Big Mines has been increased.

The demo still includes the Tutorial level and the first 4 levels.
What you won't see in the demo:
[list]
[*] Underwater Currents
[*] The Razor Bushes
[*] Ancient Fish (Twice as powerful and regenerative ability)
[*] Magnetic Mines.
[*] The Black Hole Mines.
[*] Blood Doors (Door requiring a fish sacrifice to open).
[*] Ancient Razor Bushes (Twice as deadly as Razor Bushes)
[*] Dark Fish (Twice as powerful as an Ancient Fish)
[/list]

The game is officially in BETA!
The Build will be sent to Steam for validation.

If all goes well, next weekend you will know the official release date :)

[b]I wish you good game![/b]

[i]Olivier Raveneau[/i]
[i]Mars Touch Studio[/i]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2178190/Underwater_Diving/

notes.title: NEW UNDERWATER DIVING DEMO AVAILABLE
notes.notes:
Good Morning! Good Afternoon! Good Evening! Good Night!

First of all thank you to all those who have chosen to follow the news of the game.

I am pleased to announce that the new [b]Underwater Diving[/b] demo is now available.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2427780

The purpose of this demo is to showcase the game mechanics and what the game experience will be like.
Please take into account that during the first levels you will have to favor avoidance maneuvers and choose your battles carefully.
Later, you will be able to face more and more opponents at the same time, up to epic battles.
The levels of the game will then be bigger and bigger, putting your sense of direction to the test.
I'm aiming for a game that I will finish in 4 hours, so for you, from [b]8 to 12[/b].
I hope you have a good time playing it!

Normally the game had to be played without a map
But as players no longer have the patience to draw the level map with paper and pencil.
I still added a radar which will map the level for you.
The map will remain basic, because exploration and using your sense of direction is part of the game's identity.

The demo includes the Tutorial Level and the first four levels.
Please note that levels 5 and 6 are completed and that I still have the next 6 levels to produce.
Level 6 will introduce Underwater Currents and Razor Bushes.
You will also not see in the demo:
[list]
[*] Ancient Fish (Twice as powerful and regenerative capacity)
[*] Magnetic Mines.
[*] The Black Hole Mines.
[/list]

The game's release is scheduled for [b]early June[/b].

[b]I wish you good game![/b]

notes.title: UNDERWATER DIVING DEMO NOW AVAILABLE
notes.notes:
Good Morning! Good Afternoon! Good Evening! Good Night!

First of all thank you to all those who have chosen to follow the news of the game.

I am [b]Olivier Raveneau[/b] a solo game developer creating games using the [b]Mars Touch Studio[/b] trademark.
If as a player I've been on Steam for more than 19 years, it's only been 9 months as a developer.
I still need a little time to master the platform and its communication tools.
Underwater Diving is my second commercial game on Steam.
If the difficulty doesn't scare you, try the [b]Ninja Scroller[/b] demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2150800/Ninja_Scroller/

I am pleased to announce that the first demo of [b]Underwater Diving[/b] is now available.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2427780

The purpose of this demo is to showcase the game mechanics and what the game experience will be like.
Please take into account that the game is not yet balanced.
You quickly become overpowered in a few levels.
The adversities you will encounter in the demo will cause you much less damage than in the final version.
In the final version, during the first levels, you will have to favor avoidance maneuvers and choose your fights carefully.
Then you can face more and more opponents at the same time, up to epic battles.
The game levels will also get bigger and bigger, putting your sense of direction to the test.
I'm aiming for a game that I will finish in 4 hours, so for you, [b]8 to 12 hours[/b].
Hope you have a good time playing it!

With this demo you will be able to indirectly follow the evolution of the project.
Because the demo will be updated regularly as the game develops.
If you like this version, you should like the next one even more.
If not, you might like the next one.

For this game, I'm going to try broadcasting my games with the development version.
This will allow me to show you levels in preview, unavailable in the demo.

[b]Underwater Diving[/b] will be participating in June's [b]Steam Next Fest[/b].
So, I will need a final quality demo for the event.

The release of the game is scheduled for the [b]end of July[/b].
I will postpone this date if I am not satisfied with the game.

[b]I wish you good game![/b]

[i]Olivier Raveneau[/i]
[i]Mars Touch Studio[/i]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2178190/Underwater_Diving/
